  - tag: forward_local
    type: forward
    args:
      concurrent: 10
      upstreams:
        - addr: 223.5.5.5

  - tag: forward_remote
    type: forward
    args:
      concurrent: 5

        - addr: https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
        - addr: https://dns.google/dns-query
  - tag: forward_remote_fallback
    type: forward
    args:
      concurrent: 10
      upstreams:
        - addr: 223.5.5.5

    args:

      - matches:

  - tag: remote_dns_fallback
    type: sequence
    args:
      - exec: query_summary forward_remote_fallback
      - exec: $forward_remote_fallback
      - matches:
          - '!has_resp'

  - tag: proxy_dns
    type: fallback
    args:

  - tag: proxy_dns_seq

      entry: sequence_main
      listen: :53
